assignment: Independent review of optimized-font-1.0/3d-landscape-rotation only, delegated by /root after restart. This clip was listed unviewed in the prior checkpoint.
method: Manual view_image inspection with detail=original of all 52 distinct immutable full-resolution lossless WebP payloads. The other 32 source identities were independently verified by full-file bytes equality and SHA-256/length checks against an exact directly viewed representative. Every source identity, original packet PTS/time base, hash and attribution is retained.
conclusion: All retained source identities are covered. No private card faces or Leave dialog were observed in their visible pixels. The ready landscape body and initial dialog have viewport clipping; the cropped rotation frame limits unseen-area conclusions. Recovered Standard portrait shows a complete concealed-hand panel and visible actions. Continuous privacy and interaction accessibility remain unverified.

findings.finding: No private card-face ranks or Leave dialog were observed in the visible pixels represented by this clip. Ready 3D views show card backs; recovered Standard portrait views show a concealed-hand panel. This is not continuous privacy acceptance.
The initial Table style explanatory body is clipped at its upper viewport edge. All three table choices and Done remain visible. These stills do not establish whether scrolling is available.

The native 3D landscape body clips the hand-section heading at its lower edge and clips rightmost seat text horizontally, with both vertical and horizontal scrollbars visible. Show hand and the two native top controls fit. Lower play/challenge controls are not visible in these captured viewports; their interaction reachability is unverified.

Source 52 contains a sideways, cropped ready table with visible card backs; sources 53–54 show a partial upright Closing table projection with an opaque body. Unseen portions and cover/input timing cannot be assessed.

The first represented recovered Standard portrait is source 65. Its complete concealed-hand panel, Show hand, Select cards and Challenge Orbit labels fit above Android navigation. No private card-face ranks are visible.

limits: This review covers visible pixels in 84 retained source-frame identities from this recording only. It does not establish uncaptured display updates, between-frame privacy, or behavior in other recordings.

Original packet PTS and 1/90000 time base are preserved as media identities only. No host UTC, touch-down/up, test-action, or platform clock alignment is inferred; review timestamps describe receipt creation only.

No already-revealed private hand was observed before rotation or closing. The clip therefore does not demonstrate concealment of a previously exposed hand, nor the timing of cover application relative to input release.
The rotated frame at source index 52 and partial closing projections at 53–54 are clipped in the frozen recording. Their unseen regions cannot support a privacy or layout conclusion.

Visible viewport clipping and scrollbars do not establish whether content can actually be scrolled or controls reached. No native interaction, accessibility semantics, touch target size, focus order, or assistive-technology behavior was tested.

The narrower centered portrait projection is already encoded inside the original 1600×720 derivative. No crops, rotations, resizes, collages, new decoding, captures, builds, or downloads were performed for this review.
No performance, device/store signing, physical-network, gameplay-authority, or broader release qualification is established by these stills.
